items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer. There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship between Ben Sidran and Monk Rowe beyond the current interview context.

ctx.x: Ben was interviewed via Zoom on November 15, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Ben Sidran with me this morning, and 9:00 your time, so thanks for starting out — did you have your coffee I hope?
No, I was going to get it and the next thing I knew the time ran over me and so I’m going to really freeform it here.
